plan.failureSummary: Cached page.ai step failed to find 'Last Name' input field because the survey form layout shifted to 'Your Name'.
observedIndicators: Failure occurred during deterministic cache replay inside .cache-lock/unstable-survey.test.ts.cache.js (failureInCacheReplay = true).
The failure screenshot shows 'Your Name *' and 'Contact Email *' fields instead of the cached 'Last Name *' selector.
Run mode was DETERMINISTIC and this was not a retry attempt (isRetryAttempt = false).
Zero browser or console errors recorded; the application is functioning normally.
Overall objective is semantically flexible and intended to adapt to shifting layouts.

remediationSteps.summary: Clear Page.AI cache and retry test autonomously
remediationSteps.details: Clear the Page.AI cache for tests/unstable-survey.test.ts and trigger an automated retry so page.ai executes autonomously against the current form layout.

additionalDataRequests.description: Inspect the generated cache replay file against the newly randomized DOM layout of the survey form.

plan.notes: The survey application randomly changes field names, labels, and layouts across loads. The DETERMINISTIC cache replayed instructions expecting 'Last Name *', but the live DOM presented 'Your Name *'. Clearing cache and performing an autonomous retry will allow page.ai to adapt to the current form structure.
